mapper.select: SELECT T.PROGRAM_TYPE_CD, T.PROGRAM_TYPE_NM, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(R.SCHL_NM), '')) AS RESERVED_SCHOOL_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN R.LRN_STTS_CD = 'DONE' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(R.SCHL_NM), '') END) AS VISITED_SCHOOL_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(R.RSVT_NOPE, 0)), 0) AS RESERVED_STUDENT_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.ATND_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL )), 0) AS ATTENDED_STUDENT_COUNT FROM ( SELECT 'MISSION' AS PROGRAM_TYPE_CD, '미션' AS PROGRAM_TYPE_NM, 1 AS SORT_ORDER UNION ALL SELECT 'EXPLORE', '사건탐구', 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'TOTAL', '합계', 3 ) T LEFT JOIN EDU_RSVT_MST R ON (T.PROGRAM_TYPE_CD = 'TOTAL' OR R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = T.PROGRAM_TYPE_CD) AND GROUP BY T.PROGRAM_TYPE_CD, T.PROGRAM_TYPE_NM, T.SORT_ORDER ORDER BY T.SORT_ORDER

SELECT R.SCHL_NM, COALESCE( GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN S.CLAS_NM IS NULL OR TRIM(S.CLAS_NM) = '' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(CONCAT( CASE WHEN R.SCYR_NM IS NULL OR TRIM(R.SCYR_NM) = '' THEN '' WHEN R.SCYR_NM LIKE '%학년' THEN R.SCYR_NM ELSE CONCAT(R.SCYR_NM, '학년') END, ' ', S.CLAS_NM )) END ORDER BY R.SCYR_NM, S.CLAS_NM SEPARATOR ', ' ), GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN R.SCYR_NM IS NULL OR TRIM(R.SCYR_NM) = '' THEN NULL WHEN R.SCYR_NM LIKE '%학년' THEN R.SCYR_NM ELSE CONCAT(R.SCYR_NM, '학년') END ORDER BY R.SCYR_NM SEPARATOR ', ' ) ) AS GRADE_CLASS_NM, COUNT(DISTINCT R.RSVT_SN) AS VISIT_COUNT, COUNT(S.STDNT_SN) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN S.ATND_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ATTENDED_STUDENT_COUNT, MAX(R.RSVT_YMD) AS LAST_VISIT_DATE FROM EDU_RSVT_MST R LEFT JOIN EDU_RSVT_STDNT S ON S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL WHERE AND R.SCHL_NM IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(R.SCHL_NM) != '' GROUP BY R.SCHL_NM ORDER BY VISIT_COUNT DESC, TOTAL_STUDENT_COUNT DESC, R.SCHL_NM
